topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Well, it seems the winds of change blow even in the quietest of hamlets. Jon, he who's been at my side through sowing and reaping, mending fences and tending to the goats, is leaving. They say he's off to the big town, where the streets are paved with gold and the skies are lit by lamps all day and night. It’s a bittersweet turn, like the first frost that tells you summer's end is nigh, yet brings the promise of a new beginning. I'll miss the clink of our mugs over a supper of stewed turnips and the comfort of our silences in the barn. But I know, as sure as the seasons change, that Jon's spirit and our bond, it’ll endure, woven through the very hay we've trampled over these years. May the saints watch over you, my friend, and guide your path to a future as bright as the one you've shared with me.
